text: In his pockets they placed what spies call pocket litter: the small, ordinary debris of a real person. A photograph of a fiancée named Pam. Two love letters from her. A receipt from a Bond Street jeweller for a diamond engagement ring, priced at fifty-three pounds, ten shillings and sixpence.
